Pass requirement: Every material fact has a verified ledger entry with source, date, checked_at and locator.
Numbers, quotes, dates and product capabilities use a primary or original authoritative source.
Facts, inferences, hypotheses and recommendations are not presented as the same epistemic type.
Every numeric author claim matches a verified runtime author-profile.json; synthetic canonical samples never establish real authorship.
HTML author blocks and Schema Person use a verified runtime author-profile.json; missing profile blocks fragment/integrate and never selects a synthetic example.
The article resolves one primary intent and a concrete decision job.
FAQ, table, checklist, quotes and Direct Answer appear only when useful.
The text leads with a conclusion, shows causality and avoids forbidden clichés and filler.
Keyword choice balances intent and business relevance; low frequency is not an automatic rejection.
Key passages are understandable out of context without repeating generic summaries.
At most one CTA matches funnel stage and uses a verified target URL.
One H1, allowed classes, canonical component order and no cover/head metadata inside fragment.
Visible author, FAQ, headline and image agree with Schema and metadata.
No CMS, Git or production change occurs without explicit permission and production context.
The handoff distinguishes draft, structurally validated, integrated and production-verified states.
